world.hub.npc: Which test option do you need?
world.demo.monzaemon: That's everything the demo has for now. Thanks for playing.
world.hub.tetue.1: Hi! This is a test dialogue.
world.hub.tetue.2: I want to check that the text keeps its position even as each line's length changes.
world.hub.tetue.3: This line is deliberately longer: it should wrap across several lines inside the box without the name, portrait, or continue indicator moving around while the sentence types out.
world.hub.tetue.4: Also that the portrait, the nameplate, and the continue indicator read well together.
world.hub.luzmala_npc.1: I'm also testing the hub dialogues from the left side.
world.hub.luzmala_npc.2: Now the same conversation shows mirrored, without flipping the text.
world.hub.luzmala_npc.3: And I'm back to my normal layout, to check that each line sets its own side.
world.hub.luzmala_npc.4: I can join the conversation too. The chain can switch character and portrait.
world.intro.page_1.title: Welcome
world.intro.page_2.title: Movement
world.intro.page_2.body:
Use [b]WASD[/b] to move.
Move the camera with the mouse.
Press Tab to open the menu.
world.intro.page_3.title: Enemies
world.intro.page_3.body:
If an enemy touches you, it intercepts you and combat starts.
The combat system is a kind of tactical deck builder.
world.intro.page_4.title: LAB
world.intro.page_4.body:
Another key mechanic is the incremental lab.
You can access it by talking to the NPC inside the lab.
world.intro.page_5.title: Care
world.intro.page_5.body:
Press [b]G[/b] to open the care menu.
From there you can reward, punish, or play with your Youn.
